{{Infobox election | election_name = United States House of Representatives elections in Idaho, 2018 | country = Idaho | type = legislative | ongoing = yes | previous_election = United States House of Representatives elections in Idaho, 2016 | previous_year = 2016 | next_election = United States House of Representatives elections in Idaho, 2020 | next_year = 2020 | seats_for_election = All 2 Idaho seats to the [[United States House of Representatives]] | election_date = {{Start date|2018|11|06}} | party1 = Republican Party (United States) | last_election1 = 2 | seats1 = | seat_change1 = | popular_vote1 = | percentage1 = | swing1 = | party2 = Democratic Party (United States) | last_election2 = 0 | seats2 = | seat_change2 = | popular_vote2 = | percentage2 = | swing2 = }} {{ElectionsID}} The '''2018 United States House of Representatives elections in Idaho''' will be held on Tuesday, November 6, 2018, to elect the two [[United States House of Representatives|U.S. Representatives]] from the [[U.S. state]] of [[Idaho]]; one from each of the state's two congressional districts. Primaries will be held on May 15, 2018. The elections and primaries will coincide with the elections and primaries of other federal and state offices. {{Toclimit|limit=2}} ==District 1== {{seealso|Idaho's 1st congressional district}} The incumbent is Republican [[Raúl Labrador]], who has represented the district since 2011. He was reelected with 68% of the vote in 2016. ===Democratic primary=== * Cristina McNeil, real estate agent, chair of the Latino caucus of the [[Idaho Democratic
